FORM 10-K
ANNUAL REPORT PURSUANT TO SECTION 13 OR 15(d) OF THE SECURITIES EXCHANGE ACT OF 1934
For the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023
AMAZON.COM, INC.
(Exact name of Registrant as specified in its charter)

PART II
Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations
Overview:
Our primary source of revenue is the sale of a wide range of products and services to customers. Products and services sold include retail merchandise, cloud computing services through AWS, digital media subscriptions, and advertising services.

Consolidated Statements of Operations
(In millions, except per share data)
Year Ended December 31, 2023, 2022, and 2021

Net product sales: $255,887 million
Net service sales: $318,898 million
Total net sales: $574,785 million in 2023 ($574.8 billion), compared with $513,983 million in 2022, representing an increase of 12%.

Operating expenses:
Cost of sales: $304,527 million
Fulfillment: $84,276 million
Technology and content: $85,622 million
Sales and marketing: $44,370 million
General and administrative: $11,811 million
Total operating expenses: $537,923 million

Operating income: $36,862 million in 2023, compared with $12,248 million in 2022.

Total non-operating income/(expense): $(938) million
Income before income taxes: $37,800 million
Provision for income taxes: $7,375 million
Net income: $30,425 million in 2023, compared with a net loss of $2,722 million in 2022.

Basic earnings per share: $2.95
Diluted earnings per share: $2.90

UNITED STATES SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION
Washington, D.C. 20549
FORM 10-K
ANNUAL REPORT PURSUANT TO SECTION 13 OR 15(d) OF THE SECURITIES EXCHANGE ACT OF 1934
For the fiscal year ended September 30, 2023
APPLE INC.
(Exact name of Registrant as specified in its charter)

PART II
Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations
Fiscal Year 2023 Highlights:
Total net sales decreased 2.8% or $11.0 billion during fiscal year 2023 compared to fiscal year 2022, driven primarily by lower net sales of Mac, Wearables, Home and Accessories and iPad, partially offset by an increase in Services net sales. Products net sales decreased 5.7% or $18.1 billion, while Services net sales increased 9.0% or $7.1 billion.

Consolidated Statements of Operations
(In millions, except number of shares which are reflected in thousands and per share amounts)
Years ended September 30, 2023, September 24, 2022 and September 25, 2021

Total net sales:
Fiscal Year 2023: $383,285 million
Fiscal Year 2022: $394,328 million
Fiscal Year 2021: $365,817 million

Cost of sales:
Products cost of sales in 2023: $214,137 million
Services cost of sales in 2023: $27,157 million
Total cost of sales in 2023: $241,294 million
Gross margin: $141,991 million in 2023 compared to $170,782 million in 2022.

Operating expenses:
Research and development (R&D): $29,915 million
Selling, general and administrative (SG&A): $24,932 million
Total operating expenses: $54,847 million
Operating income: $114,301 million in 2023 compared to $119,437 million in 2022.

Other income/(expense), net: $(382) million
Income before provision for income taxes: $113,736 million
Provision for income taxes: $16,741 million
Net income: $96,995 million in 2023, compared to $99,803 million in 2022 and $94,680 million in 2021.

Earnings per share:
Basic earnings per share: $6.16
Diluted earnings per share: $6.13
Shares used in computing earnings per share:
Basic: 15,744,231 thousand
Diluted: 15,812,547 thousand

Segment Operating Performance
Americas:
Net sales in Americas were $162,560 million in 2023 compared to $169,658 million in 2022. Operating income was $60,477 million.

Europe:
Net sales in Europe were $94,294 million in 2023 compared to $95,118 million in 2022. Operating income was $35,274 million.

Greater China:
Net sales in Greater China were $72,559 million in 2023 compared to $74,202 million in 2022. Operating income was $29,985 million.

Japan:
Net sales in Japan were $24,257 million in 2023 compared to $25,977 million in 2022. Operating income was $11,048 million.

Rest of Asia Pacific:
Net sales were $29,615 million in 2023 compared to $29,373 million in 2022.

Research and Development (R&D) Expense Breakdown:
The Company continues to invest in research and development to support new technologies and product enhancements. Total research and development expense was $29,915 million for fiscal year 2023, representing approximately 7.8% of total net sales. R&D spending increased by $3,664 million or 14% year-over-year, driven primarily by headcount-related expenses and project-related engineering costs.

UNITED STATES SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION
Washington, D.C. 20549
FORM 10-K
ANNUAL REPORT PURSUANT TO SECTION 13 OR 15(d) OF THE SECURITIES EXCHANGE ACT OF 1934
For the fiscal year ended June 30, 2023
MICROSOFT CORPORATION
(Exact name of Registrant as specified in its charter)

BUSINESS OVERVIEW
Microsoft is a technology company whose mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We strive to create local opportunity, growth, and impact in every country around the world. We generate revenue by offering a wide range of cloud-based solutions, software licenses, devices, and support services.

INCOME STATEMENTS
(In millions, except per share amounts)
Year Ended June 30, 2023, 2022, and 2021

Revenue:
Product revenue: $64,699 million
Service and other revenue: $147,216 million
Total revenue: $211,915 million in fiscal year 2023, compared to $198,270 million in fiscal year 2022 and $168,088 million in 2021.
Total revenue increased $13,645 million or 7% year-over-year.

Cost of revenue:
Product cost of revenue: $18,219 million
Service and other cost of revenue: $47,644 million
Total cost of revenue: $65,863 million
Gross margin: $146,052 million in 2023 compared to $135,620 million in 2022.

Research and development expense: $27,195 million
Sales and marketing expense: $22,759 million
General and administrative expense: $7,575 million
Total operating expenses: $57,529 million

Operating income:
Total operating income was $88,523 million in fiscal year 2023, compared to $83,383 million in fiscal year 2022, representing an increase of 6%.

Other income/(expense), net: $788 million
Income before income taxes: $89,311 million
Provision for income taxes: $16,950 million
Net income: $72,361 million in 2023, compared to $72,738 million in 2022.

Diluted earnings per share: $9.68 in 2023 compared to $9.65 in 2022.
